title: BusductTherMo — Modbus & Joint Configuration (cfg/modbus + cfg/joints)
description: Commissioning-time configuration describing physical wiring reality. Versioned independently from alarm thresholds. Applied atomically; edge validates schema AND cross-field rules (see x-edge-validation) before accepting.

ambient_sensor_ref.description: Which slave/channel provides ambient T for delta-T computation. Resolution order when more than one level sets this: joints[].ambient_sensor, then zones[].ambient_sensor for the joint's zone, then modbus.ambient_sensor (panel-wide default) - see R9/R14.

config_domain_versions.description: Monotonic version per domain. Edge rejects a push whose version is <= currently applied version for that domain.

rs485_max_devices.description: Electrical device ceiling for this segment, set by transceiver unit load: 32 (1 UL), 128 (1/4 UL, e.g. MAX487E family), 256 (1/8 UL). Enforced by R16.

slave_id.description: Logical ID referenced by joints. Stable even if unit_address changes.

label.description: Display name shown on dashboards/alerts, e.g. 'Sensor7' (legacy parameterName)

channels.description: Number of temperature channels on this module

channel_addrs.description: Per-channel start address (index k = channel k+1) for modules whose channels are not consecutive words from temp_base_addr. Length must equal channels, addresses unique and non-overlapping, min must equal temp_base_addr (R15). Absent = channels are consecutive: channel k at temp_base_addr + (k-1)*temp_word_count.

channel_labels.description: Per-channel display name (index k = channel k+1), e.g. the probe location. Length must equal channels when present (R15).

joint_id.description: Display ID used on HMI, heat map, alarms, cloud payloads

label.description: Human location, e.g. 'Riser bend, above ACB-8'

threshold_profile.description: Optional per-joint override profile name defined in cfg/alarms; 'default' = panel-wide thresholds

ambient_sensor.description: Optional per-joint override, for a joint whose local ambient differs from its zone's (e.g. right next to a vent/doorway). Falls back to the zone's ambient_sensor, then modbus.ambient_sensor.
Optional zone-level ambient reference override (e.g. this zone runs through an air-conditioned enclosure while others are open-air). Falls back to modbus.ambient_sensor when unset.

x-edge-validation.description: Cross-field rules the edge MUST enforce beyond JSON Schema. Any failure -> reject entire push atomically, report reason on cmd/../config/ack.
rules: R1  Referential integrity: every joints[].slave_id must exist in modbus.slaves[].slave_id.
R2  Referential integrity: every joints[].zone_id must exist in zones[].zone_id (if zones provided).
R3  Every slaves[].bus_id must exist in buses[].bus_id.
R4  Uniqueness: (bus_id, unit_address) pairs must be unique — no duplicate Modbus addresses on one bus.
R5  Uniqueness: slave_id values unique; joint_id values unique; zone_id values unique.
R6  Channel range: joints[].channel <= channels of the referenced slave.

R7  No double mapping: (slave_id, channel) referenced by at most one joint, and not by any effective ambient_sensor (modbus.ambient_sensor, any zones[].ambient_sensor, or any joints[].ambient_sensor override) simultaneously.
R8  Bus type consistency: RTU buses require port+baud; TCP buses require host. Reject mixed/missing fields.

R9  Ambient present: if any alarm profile uses delta-T, every joint must resolve an effective ambient sensor - its own ambient_sensor override, else its zone's ambient_sensor, else modbus.ambient_sensor (panel-wide default). At least one of these must be set for every joint.
R10 Capacity: total poll load (slaves x registers / poll_interval) must fit bus timing (edge computes worst-case scan time; reject if scan time > shortest poll_interval).
R11 Version monotonicity: incoming config_domain_versions.{modbus|joints} must be > currently applied version for that domain.
R12 Maintenance gate: remote (cloud-originated) changes to modbus or joints domains are accepted only when panel is in maintenance mode; local UI/commissioning tool changes are exempt.
R13 On any accepted change: write before/after to audit trail, publish applied versions on ack/reported channel, keep last-known-good snapshot for boot fallback.

R14 Referential integrity: any ambient_sensor set at panel (modbus), zone, or joint level must reference an existing slave_id, and its channel must be within that slave's channel count. Checked whenever the field is present, independent of R9/alarms usage.

R15 Per-channel register integrity: when registers.channel_addrs is present its length must equal channels, addresses must be unique and spaced >= temp_word_count apart (no overlapping reads), and min(channel_addrs) must equal temp_base_addr; when registers.channel_labels is present its length must equal channels.

R16 RS-485 bus loading: the number of slaves assigned to any single bus must not exceed rs485_max_devices for that bus (default 128, the quarter-unit-load ceiling of the MAX487E-class transceiver). A bus loaded above 80% of that ceiling is accepted but reported as a warning, since it leaves no headroom for repeaters, diagnostic taps or growth.
